channel.title: Field notes — Zheng Xiangsheng
channel.description: Working notes on transformation optics, geodesic lenses and quantum optics.

item.title: Why a lens is a surface
item.description: The metric equivalence that turns a gradient-index problem into a problem of curved geometry — and why the Luneburg lens is exactly a sphere.

item.title: Tracing a ray through the Morse lens
item.description: Four equations, a step size, and a convergence check: what it takes to trust a numerically traced ray, and what the Morse profile actually does.

item.title: One photon at a time
item.description: Interference without a second photon, the quantitative trade between visibility and path information, and what a teaching lab really measures.
